refinement: prospective authenticated, incarnation-bound monotonic heartbeat trace with external host-regime measurement

candidate.host_counter: Windows GetSystemTimes sampled by observer at approximately 1Hz
candidate.host_regime: ordinary if aggregate busy_pct < 50.0; elevated if >= 50.0

auditor.input: results/a01/ raw files and frozen source hashes

scope: One controlled healthy local child process. Trace-capture feasibility only; no detector comparison or performance inference.
stopping_rule: Stop at 600 seconds or immediately on candidate/sensor failure; retain the first outcome. No retry, threshold tuning, or replacement allocation.
